verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own reporting capabilities that touch payroll data: AI-built reports and dashboards on labor costs, a report builder that joins and pivots data with calculated fields, global compensation trend reporting, and pay-run comparison. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports, or describes exporting reports for analysis. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report, documented export (CSV/Excel), independent or hands-on corroboration.
